strategic_priorities.text: Our strategy is to deliver insights and experiences that make us essential to investor workflow.
strategic_priorities.quote: Our strategy is to deliver insights and experiences that make us essential to investor workflow. Proprietary data sets, meaningful analytics, independent research, and effective investment strategies are at the core of the powerful digital solutions that investors across our client segments rely on.

strategic_priorities.text: Deliver differentiated insights across asset classes to public and private market investors
strategic_priorities.quote: Deliver differentiated insights across asset classes to public and private market investors

strategic_priorities.text: Leverage advances in AI to drive innovation across internal and external products and services
strategic_priorities.quote: Leverage advances in AI to drive innovation across internal and external products and services

strategic_priorities.text: Drive operational excellence and scalability to support growth targets
strategic_priorities.quote: Drive operational excellence and scalability to support growth targets

strategic_priorities.text: Build an inclusive culture that drives exceptional talent engagement and development
strategic_priorities.quote: Build an inclusive culture that drives exceptional talent engagement and development

strategic_priorities.text: Expanding our data, research, and analytics to deliver unique, personalized, and impactful insights to investors across asset classes in public and private markets alike.
strategic_priorities.quote: • Expanding our data, research, and analytics to deliver unique, personalized, and impactful insights to investors across asset classes in public and private markets alike.

strategic_priorities.text: Providing regulatory and compliance solutions for our wealth, buy-side, and asset management clients
strategic_priorities.quote: • Providing regulatory and compliance solutions for our wealth, buy-side, and asset management clients to help them navigate the dynamic regulatory environment with an ecosystem of data, research, content, tools, and analytics.

strategic_priorities.text: Scaling corporate systems to create resilient and more integrated platforms that enable growth of business areas while reducing legacy system fragmentation.
strategic_priorities.quote: • Scaling corporate systems to create resilient and more integrated platforms that enable growth of business areas while reducing legacy system fragmentation.

strategic_priorities.text: A key aspect of our growth strategy is to expand our investment and credit research capabilities and enhance our existing products and services.
strategic_priorities.quote: A key aspect of our growth strategy is to expand our investment and credit research capabilities and enhance our existing products and services.

strategic_priorities.text: Retiring the US TAMP to concentrate on distribution of investment products on third-party platforms
strategic_priorities.quote: In 2024, we sold customer assets from the US Morningstar Wealth Turnkey Asset Management Platform (TAMP) to AssetMark and announced that we would be retiring our US TAMP in 2025 to concentrate on the distribution of our investment products on third-party platforms in that market.

segments.name: Morningstar Data and Analytics
segments.note: In 2024, the company sold its Commodity and Energy Data business, which was included in this segment
segments.quote: In 2024, we sold our Commodity and Energy Data business, which was included in the Morningstar Data and Analytics segment.

segments.name: PitchBook
segments.quote: We operate our business through five reportable segments: Morningstar Data and Analytics, PitchBook, Morningstar Wealth, Morningstar Credit, and Morningstar Retirement.

segments.name: Morningstar Wealth
segments.note: In February 2025, the company announced plans to retire Morningstar Office, a product in this segment
segments.quote: In February 2025, we announced that we plan to retire Morningstar Office, our practice and portfolio management software for registered investment advisors (RIAs).

segments.name: Morningstar Credit
segments.quote: Morningstar Credit provides investors with credit ratings, research, data, and credit analytics solutions that, we believe, contribute to the transparency of international and domestic credit markets.

segments.name: Morningstar Retirement
segments.quote: Morningstar Retirement offers products designed to help individuals reach their retirement goals.

segments.name: Corporate and All Other
segments.quote: Corporate and All Other includes unallocated corporate expenses as well as financial results from Morningstar Sustainalytics and Morningstar Indexes.

headcount.as_stated: As of December 31, 2024, we had 11,085 permanent, full-time employees around the world.
headcount.quote: As of December 31, 2024, we had 11,085 permanent, full-time employees around the world. Approximately 41% of our employees work in India, 30% in the US
